description: This file contains unit tests for verifying the SABI (System ABI) configurations for different architectures and API versions, using Google Test framework. It includes predefined JSON strings for various platform configurations and a test case that checks if the current platform's SABI matches one of the supported configurations.

classes.name: SabiTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for SABI verification tests.

methods.name: VerifySABI
methods.description: Test method that logs current API version and SABI, then checks if the current SABI configuration is among the supported set.
